data.name: Maula
data.gender_notes: Maula is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over, deity, god, master, lord. The name Maula carries the meaning “God, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Maula usually hope their child will grow to embody god, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence of a higher power, the ultimate ruler of the universe
data.etymology: Maula belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God, Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maula total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
